verdict.rationale: HubSpot's deduplication docs say it automatically deduplicates contacts by email address and companies by domain name. Record IDs can also be used to manually deduplicate contacts, companies and other objects, so the core dedupe capability exists. However, the evidence never describes a duplicate-detection or review tool for an ops user, the merge workflow itself, or how property values and associations are kept when records are combined. Missing for 10: a documented duplicate-detection or review tool, explicit merge mechanics, guarantees that properties and associations survive a merge, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
